checks.nl_assertion: Agent correctly identified that the changes requested by the user cannot be done because the policy stipulates that modification of origin, destination or trip type of a flight is not allowed.
checks.justification: The agent did not identify that the requested changes (changing origin from LAX to ATL, destination from ATL to LAS, and trip type from round-trip to one-way) violate the policy. Instead, the agent processed the change and updated the reservation, which should not have been allowed.
